label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 134 ]

blocks.text: We simply do not have the technology to travel to the nearest star in human lifetime. Will this change? Yes and no. Humans are learning how to travel faster and faster. But like all beings in the universe, we face a speed limit, the speed of light, which is about 300,000 kilometers per second. Today our spaceships are only capable of less than one percent the speed of light. Because of this , we explore the universe by observing it with all kinds of telescope.

readingSentences.english: We simply do not have the technology to travel to the nearest star in human lifetime.
readingSentences.korean: 우리는 우리의 평생 동안에 가장 가까이 있는 별에 여행할 기술을 갖고 있지 못하다.

readingSentences.english: Humans are learning how to travel faster and faster.
readingSentences.korean: 인간은 점점 더 빨리 여행하는 법을 배우고 있다.

readingSentences.english: But like all beings in the universe, we face a speed limit, the speed of light, which is about 300,000 kilometers per second.
readingSentences.korean: 그러나 우주의 모든 존재들처럼, 우리는 속도의 한계, 초당 30만km인 광속의 한계에 직면해 있다.

readingSentences.english: Today our spaceships are only capable of less than one percent the speed of light.
Because of this , we explore the universe by observing it with all kinds of telescope.
readingSentences.korean: 이 때문에, 우리는 모든 종류의 망원경을 가지고 우주를 관찰함으로서 우주를 탐험하고 있다.
